meta.description: The configuration card through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn and useItem: reading a configured machine, applying to a default one, other machine types, an empty card, other blocks, use in the air, tooltips.
meta.fields: marks [step, ...]; step: read (sneaking click on the source machine A with an empty card), read_overwrite (the same with a card that already holds another machine's data), apply (non sneaking click on a default machine B with the card from a read), apply_empty (a card with no data), other_block (stone, chest, air), use_air (ServerPlayerGameMode.useItem), tooltip (the card's tooltip); source/target (machine names or block names); face (world Direction clicked; the machines face north); sneak; data (whether the card held data before); result {class, consumes_action, swing_source, was_item_interaction, held_item_transformed} of ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn (or useItem for use_air); exception; menu (the player's containerMenu after the call: {type, class} or null; closed right after); overlay (overlay messages, Component JSON); chat; payloads (custom payload ids); card_before and card_after (the stack in hand: item, count, patch, configuration_data = the SNBT of mekanism:configuration_data's compound or null, configuration_json = the same compound as sorted JSON); clicked_before/clicked_after (snapshot of the machine or block under the click, A for read and read_overwrite, B for the others: block, tile, facing, control_type, config, ejecting, ejector, energy, slots); A is configured: item default sides replaced by the pattern where side i of each type has the supported DataType of index (i + 1 + ordinal of the type) mod count, ejecting on for ITEM, strict input, output color DARK_GREEN, input colors LEFT=RED and BOTTOM=DARK_BLUE, redstone HIGH. B is the item default with ejecting off, strict input off, output color YELLOW, input color TOP=PINK, redstone LOW. Both are placed by the player facing north; the Heat Generator only has the redstone mode. result_hand (use_air only): the stack in hand after the call. tooltip lines: Component JSON of ItemStack.getTooltipLines (no player, TooltipFlag.NORMAL).
